name: The Secret Saturdays
s: An adventuresome family of experts in the field of creatures known as cryptids attempts to protect their secrets and powers from the forces of evil.

paragraphs.text: The Secret Saturdays is an American animated television series created by Canadian cartoonist Jay Stephens and produced by PorchLight Entertainment for Cartoon Network. The series ran from October 3, 2008, to January 30, 2010. It follows the adventures of the eponymous family of cryptozoologists that work to keep the truth about cryptids from getting out, to protect both the human race and the creatures themselves. The Saturdays travel the Earth searching for cryptids to study and battling twisted villains like the megalomaniac V. V. Argost. The series is influenced by 1960s-era Hanna-Barbera action series and Jay Stephens's interest in cryptozoology.

The series contained numerous references to the characters and events of the Ben 10 franchise over its run, set in the same fictional universe. Conseqently, following the conclusion of The Secret Saturdays, the Saturday family returned in the Ben 10: Omniverse episode "T.G.I.S." ("Thank God It's Saturday"), aired October 5, 2013, with Drew Saturday later appearing in the episode "The Most Dangerous Game Show", aired November 12, 2014.
